scope: Real API worker; 30-second offered schedule, synthetic 100ms provider, no warmup. Final durable states after shutdown. Starts aggregated by second; queue wait percentiles computed over every provider start including drain. Failed-case wait excludes jobs never started. Offered-minus-returns includes in-flight work and producer lag; it is not a durable pending-state count. No universal rate limit is established by these local short runs.
